license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "The Missouri State Board of Nursing" shall consist of nine members

name.quote: "The Missouri State Board of Nursing" shall consist of nine members

type.quote: "The Missouri State Board of Nursing" shall consist of nine members, five of whom must be registered professional nurses.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Registration, Department of Commerce and Insurance
umbrella_agency.quote: Missouri state board of nursing, chapter 335

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: Registered professional nurse: completed basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma; APRN: completed an accredited graduate-level advanced practice registered nurse program
degree_required.quote: have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved school of nursing (RN/LPN); accredited graduate-level APRN program (APRN)
accrediting_body.quote: have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing

degree_level.quote: have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited or approved school of nursing

credential_pegged.quote: Be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the Missouri state board of nursing in the advanced practice registered nurse role

tiers.quote: have completed at least two years of high school, or its equivalent as established by the state board of education, and have successfully completed a basic prescribed curriculum in a state-accredited or approved school of nursing, earned a nursing degree, certificate or diploma
have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

Have completed an accredited graduate-level advanced practice registered nurse program and achieved at least one certification as a clinical nurse specialist, nurse midwife, nurse practitioner, or registered nurse anesthetist

required.quote: have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

experience_source.quote: have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Board requires passage of examination for RN licensure
exams.quote: The applicant must be approved by the board and shall pass an examination as required by the board.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Board requires passage of examination for LPN licensure
exams.quote: The applicant must be approved by the board and shall pass an examination as required by the board.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered professional nurse, or a licensed practical nurse without examination to an applicant who has duly become licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse pursuant to the laws of another state, territory, or foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must meet the qualifications required of APRNs, RNs, or LPNs in Missouri at the time the applicant was originally licensed in the other state, territory, or foreign country.
requirements.quote: if the applicant meets the qualifications required of advanced practice registered nurses, registered nurses, or licensed practical nurses in this state at the time the applicant was originally licensed in the other state, territory, or foreign country.

exists.quote: "The Missouri State Board of Nursing" shall consist of nine members, five of whom must be registered professional nurses. One member of the board shall be a licensed practical nurse, one member shall be an advanced practice registered nurse, and one member a voting public member.

national_certification.value: Council on Certification of Nurse Anesthetists / National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists; American Midwifery Certification Board
national_certification.quote: currently certified as a nurse anesthetist by the Council on Certification of Nurse Anesthetists, the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists, or other nationally recognized certifying body approved by the board of nursing

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: "Licensure", the issuing of a license to candidates who have met the requirements specified under this chapter, authorizing the person to engage in the practice of advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing

is_mandatory.quote: Practice nursing as defined by sections 335.011 to 335.099 unless duly licensed to do so under the provisions of sections 335.011 to 335.099

title_protection.quote: No other person shall use the title "Registered Professional Nurse" or the abbreviation "RN". No other person shall assume any title or use any abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs, or devices to indicate that the person using the same is a registered professional nurse.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use or unlawful possession of any controlled substance or alcoholic beverage impairing ability to perform nursing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use or unlawful possession of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, by the federal government, or by the department of health and senior services by regulation, regardless of impairment, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication or guilty plea for offense related to nursing duties, fraud, dishonesty, violence, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution pursuant to the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a license or examination permission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, gross negligence, or repeated negligence in performance of nursing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, gross negligence, or repeated negligence in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical or unprofessional conduct in nursing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical conduct, or unprofessional conduct in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or assisting violation of nursing statutes or lawful rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 335.011 to 335.096, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of a licensed person or allowing use of one's license by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against a license in another state for grounds that would warrant discipline in Missouri
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096 granted by another state, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of insanity or incompetency by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling an unlicensed person to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096 who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: License issued based on a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertisement or solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of drug laws or regulations of any state or federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placement on an employee disqualification list by any state or federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placement on an employee disqualification list or other related restriction or finding pertaining to employment within a health-related profession issued by any state or federal government or agency following final disposition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to successfully complete the intervention or alternative program for substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to successfully complete the intervention or alternative program for substance use disorder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making false statements to obtain Medicaid/Medicare payments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or causing to be made a false statement or misrepresentation of a material fact, with intent to defraud, for payment pursuant to the provisions of chapter 208 or chapter 630, or for payment from Title XVIII or Title XIX of the federal Medicare program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to properly guard against communicable diseases or maintaining unsanitary conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases or the spread thereof; maintaining an unsanitary office or performing professional services under unsanitary conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of personal use or abuse of controlled substances or prescription medications without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of personal use or consumption of any controlled substance or any substance which requires a prescription unless it is prescribed, dispensed, or administered by a provider who is authorized by law to do so or a pattern of abuse of any prescription medication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol, evidence of which may include more than one alcohol-related enforcement contact as defined by section 302.525

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a treatment or aftercare program from a board order or settlement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program entered into as part of a board order, settlement agreement, or licensee's professional health program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to submit to a drug or alcohol screening when requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to submit to a drug or alcohol screening when requested by an employer or by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged by a court in need of a guardian or conservator and not restored to capacity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudged by a court in need of a guardian or conservator, or both, obtaining a guardian or conservator, or both, and who has not been restored to capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion or attempting to divert medication, controlled substances, or medical supplies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion or attempting to divert any medication, controlled substance, or medical supplies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to answer, disclose, or fully provide information on any license application or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to answer, failure to disclose, or failure to fully provide all information requested on any application or renewal for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental illness or disability impairing ability to practice nursing with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skill, or disability that impairs the licensee's ability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct constituting serious danger to the health, safety, or welfare of a patient or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct that constitutes a serious danger to the health, safety, or welfare of a patient or the public.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person shall establish, conduct or maintain a residential care facility, assisted living facility, intermediate care facility, or skilled nursing facility in this state without a valid license issued by the department.

definition_quote.value: the performance for compensation of any act or action which requires substantial specialized education, judgment and skill based on knowledge and application of principles derived from the biological, physical, social, behavioral, and nursing sciences
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing", the performance for compensation of any act or action which requires substantial specialized education, judgment and skill based on knowledge and application of principles derived from the biological, physical, social, behavioral, and nursing sciences

value: administration of medications and treatments as prescribed
performance of advanced practice nursing activities consistent with education and certification
methods_authorized.quote: Responsibility for the promotion and teaching of health care and the prevention of illness to the patient and his or her family; Assessment, data collection, nursing diagnosis, nursing care, evaluation, and counsel of persons who are ill, injured, or experiencing alterations in normal health processes; The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments; The coordination and assistance in the determination and delivery of a plan of health care with all members of a health team; The teaching and supervision of other persons in the performance of any of the foregoing

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe, dispense, and administer medications and nonscheduled legend drugs within their practice and specialty. With a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority, APRNs may prescribe controlled substances within a collaborative practice arrangement with a physician.
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse's prescriptive authority shall include authority to: (1) Prescribe, dispense, and administer medications and nonscheduled legend drugs, as defined in section 338.330, within such APRN's practice and specialty

license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN", a person who is licensed under the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of advanced practice nursing as a certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist

aprn_role_categories.quote: a person who is licensed under the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of advanced practice nursing as a certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: All such nursing care shall be given under the direction of a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments or under the direction of a registered professional nurse.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Has a controlled substance prescribing authority delegated in the collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 with a physician who has an unrestricted federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board of nursing may grant a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority to an advanced practice registered nurse who: (1) Submits proof of successful completion of an advanced pharmacology course

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Has a controlled substance prescribing authority delegated in the collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 with a physician who has an unrestricted federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number

dea_registration_required.quote: Has a controlled substance prescribing authority delegated in the collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 with a physician who has an unrestricted federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number and who is actively engaged in a practice comparable in scope, specialty, or expertise to that of the advanced practice registered nurse.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: "certified nursing assistant" means an employee who has completed the training required under subsection 1 of this section, who has passed the certification exam, and who is assigned by a skilled nursing or intermediate care facility, unit, or hospital to provide or assist in the provision of direct resident health care services under the supervision of a nurse licensed under the nursing practice law, chapter 335.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: The services rendered by technicians, nurses' aides or their equivalent trained and employed in public or private hospitals and licensed long-term care facilities

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: "Multistate license", a license to practice as a registered nurse, "RN", or a licensed practical or vocational nurse, "LPN" or "VN", issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state shall be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse, "RN", or as a licensed practical or vocational nurse, "LPN" or "VN", under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The state board of nursing may establish an intervention program and an alternative program to promote the identification, intervention, treatment, and monitoring of nurses or applicants for a nursing license who may be impaired by reason of substance abuse or the potential for substance abuse.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN providing nursing services under a collaborative practice arrangement may provide such services outside the geographic proximity requirements if the collaborating physician and APRN utilize telehealth. Telehealth providers must obtain patient consent before services are initiated and ensure confidentiality of medical information.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) providing nursing services under a collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 may provide such services outside the geographic proximity requirements of section 334.104 if the collaborating physician and advanced practice registered nurse utilize telehealth. Telehealth providers shall be required to obtain patient consent before telehealth services are initiated and ensure confidentiality of medical information.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Provides evidence of a minimum of one thousand hours of practice in an advanced practice nursing category prior to application for a certificate of prescriptive authority.

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: shall require at least seventy-five classroom hours of training and one hundred hours supervised and on-the-job training.

military_education_credit_required.quote: every professional licensing board or commission in this state shall, upon presentation of satisfactory evidence by an applicant for certification or licensure, accept education, training, or service completed by an individual who is a member of the United States Armed Forces or Reserves

scope__license_tiers.quote: "Registered professional nurse" or "registered nurse", a person licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of professional nursing
"Licensed practical nurse" or "practical nurse", a person licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of practical nursing

"Certified nurse practitioner", a registered nurse who is currently certified as a nurse practitioner by a nationally recognized certifying body approved by the board of nursing

"Certified clinical nurse specialist", a registered nurse who is currently certified as a clinical nurse specialist by a nationally recognized certifying board approved by the board of nursing
"certified nursing assistant" means an employee who has completed the training required under subsection 1 of this section, who has passed the certification exam
